name: ITS Jewellery Price Plugin
author: ifelse

sections.description:
ITS Jewellery Price Plugin for Woocommerce helps to update prices of jewellery products. We all know that prices of jewellery products change everyday based on prices of precious metals such as Gold and Diamond. Changing the price of each product is a big task that needs human resources and time. With our plugin you need to only update the prices of precious metals. The plugin will take care of updating the prices of the jewellery products.

Documentation

For detailed instructions on how to configure the plugin, please visit the documentation.

Required Plugin

  • Woocommerce

Features

  • This plugin works in simple product and variable product
  • Every metal has three input fields in product edit page for weight, making charge and wastage charge
  • Standard formula is used for product price calculation
  • Changing of metal price is recorded in a separate metal price log
  • Changing of product price is recorded in a separate product price log
  • Additional information on the variable product page will be changed when the variant is changed.

Pro Features

  • Automatic Price Updates: Your jewellery prices recalculate instantly whenever you change the daily gold, silver or diamond rate – no need to edit each product by hand.
  • Add Any Metal, Unlimited Times: Gold, Silver, Platinum, Diamonds, Gemstones and any other metal or stone you deal in, in the units you prefer.
  • No Store Setup Work for You: The website product options (attributes) for every metal you add are created automatically.
  • Works for All Product Types: Whether a product has a single price or multiple options (different metals, sizes and so on), it works perfectly.
  • Flexible Making & Wastage Charges: Set making and wastage charges the way you normally do – as a percentage, a fixed amount, or per gram/unit.
  • Gross Weight Billing: Support for making and wastage charges calculated on gross weight (GWMC & GWWC), just like everyday jewellery shop practice.
  • Extra Cost Fields: Easily add Pearl cost, Stone cost, Extra fee, plus 5 more cost fields you can name yourself.
  • GST Made Easy: Set different GST rates for different metals (for example 3% on Gold, 0.25% on Gemstones) and mark items as tax-free when needed.
  • Clean Final Prices: Automatically round the final price to the nearest 1, 2, 5 or 10 so customers see neat figures.
  • Show Customers Their Price Breakup: Display exactly how a price is calculated, with ready-made designs and full control over colours, fonts and placement.
  • Flexible Placement: Show the price breakup below the Add to Cart button, inside a tab, or in a pop-up window.
  • Updates Live as Customers Choose Options: When a customer picks a different metal or size, the price and its breakup change instantly.
  • Show Today’s Metal Rates: Display your live gold, silver and diamond rates on your site as cards, a table, or a scrolling ticker.
  • Sell in Multiple Currencies: Works with the CURCY multi-currency plugin so you can price and sell in different currencies.
  • Quick Product Import & Export: Upload products from Excel or CSV with a preview and clear error messages, and export your data back out.
  • Handles Thousands of Products Smoothly: Price updates run safely in the background, so even large catalogues update without the site hanging.
  • Complete Record of Changes: See who changed which metal rate, how product prices changed, and overall activity – each stored in its own log you can clear anytime.
  • Backup & Restore Settings in One Click: Save your plugin settings safely and restore them whenever you need.
  • Discount Feature
  • Automatic Price Updater
  • Bulk Discount Feature (Metal, Making Charge, Wastage Charge, Category specific and Product specific discounts)

Shortcodes

  • Shortcode available for Price Breakup : [itsjp_price_breakup]
  • Show price breakup shortcode in popup : [itsjp_price_breakup show=”popup”]
  • Show today’s metals prices in default format: [itsjp_metal_rate]
  • Show today’s metals prices in table format: [itsjp_metal_rate template=”table” caption=”Market Price Today” metal_head=”Details” rate_head=”Rate/gm”]
  • Show today’s metals prices in marquee style: [itsjp_metal_rate template=”marquee” caption=”Market Price Today” metal_head=”Details” rate_head=”Rate/gm”]

Add on Feature

  • Price breakup details on simple and variable product page
  • Show price breakup below add to cart in default woocommerce product template
  • ITS Automatic Jewellery Price Addon – automate and simplify price adjustments with real-time metal rate updates
  • ITS Bulk Discount Addon – apply metal, making charge, wastage charge, category specific and product specific discounts

How to use this plugin?

  • Before installing this plugin you must install woocommerce plugin.
  • After activating the plugin, go to Settings >> Activate License. There is a link available to get the license key for this plugin. If you want to evaluate this plugin you can get a trial license key to test this plugin for a limited period.
  • Then go to the product and enter all the data required. You will see the extra added fields for metal weight, making charge and wastage charge.
  • After updating the product, go to ITS Jewellery Price settings page and click edit button and enter the current price of the metal and update it. Now, the plugin will take care of updating the prices of all products that are having this metal.
sections.installation:
=Installation Via WordPress Admin Area=
* Log into your WordPress admin area.
* Go to Dashboard » Plugin.
* Click on Add New Plugin button at top.
* Search for “ITS Jewellery Price”.
* Now click on the “Install Now” button of the “ITS Jewellery Price” plugin.
* Click on Activate once the plugin is installed.
* To activate the features of the plugin you need to get a license key from the plugin product page.

=Installation Using FTP=
* Download the ‘its-jewellery-price.zip’ file.
* Extract Zip file.
* Using your FTP program, upload the non-zipped plugin folder into the “/wp-content/plugins/” folder.
* Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How many metals can be added?

Adding metals is a pro feature. So the pro plugin does not restrict in adding metals. Any number of metals can be added.

Do I need to create product attributes in woocommerce for metal names added through this plugin?

Not at all. This plugin will take care of it. Product attributes will be created automatically.

Does this plugin have a metal price log page?

Yes, This plugin has a metal price log page.

Does this plugin have a product price log page?

Yes, this plugin has a product price log page.

Can I change the product price formula?

No. You can not change the product price formula. For a custom price formula you can contact the developer.

26.10.22T

  • Redesigned the Addons page with dedicated cards for the ITS Automatic Jewellery Price Addon and the new ITS Bulk Discount Addon, showing live license status and validity.
  • Added Bulk Discount Addon banner image and updated the Automatic Price Updater addon banner.
  • Fixed PHP warnings and fatal errors caused by missing product attribute terms while displaying variation details and deleting attributes.
  • Fixed license activation issue when the local key is missing from the license response.
  • Improved metal term cleanup to safely handle terms that no longer exist.
  • Updated WordPress compatibility test up to 7.1.3.
  • Updated PHP compatibility test up to 8.3.

26.07.11T

  • Optimize the code and fixed some bugs.
  • Updated WordPress compatibility test up to 7.0.1.

26.07.10T

  • Fixed bug in metal price update.
